figures.short_alt_en: Core metrics, source files, and recalculation evidence chain
figures.long_description_en: The public-facing metrics show a provisional site of about 11.4 square kilometres, green space of about 14.94 percent, public space of about 4.08 percent, and a conceptual building footprint of about 22.8 hectares. A Source–GeoJSON–EPSG:4548–Metrics–Figures–Review chain explains that exact values serve only as machine consistency evidence.

figures.long_description_en: A synthetic blue-hour aerial corridor links gold Build, coral Review, and teal Merge public nodes along a luminous double track. It expresses the Living Mainline concept and is not a site photograph, official planning rendering, surveyed geometry, or built status.
